summary: REQ-101 and REQ-102 appear to be implemented in the Hero component: the Hero second line now explicitly names the three services, and the exact phrase "sofa cleaning near me" is present in visible on-page paragraph copy. No evidence in the diff summary indicates CTA destination changes. However, the modified summary/state files describe multiple additional changes (styling/theme/SEO/chat widget/etc.) that were not requested and in some cases conflict with the BuildRequest constraints/non-goals.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/updated SEO metadata (Ahmedabad keywords, geo tags, JSON-LD) and multiple non-requested section/style changes described as part of the change set.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked for Hero service-line wording alignment and ensuring the phrase "sofa cleaning near me" is visible on-page; it explicitly says not to change overall layout beyond requested text updates. The diff summary file describes broad styling/theme/SEO updates not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Support chat widget enhancements/changes referenced in the change summary.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest Non-goals explicitly: "Do not introduce any AI-related features or chat widgets." The diff summary file references a "SupportChatWidget" and its enhancements, which is outside scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Claims of broad UI/theme changes (Royal Blue/Gold palette, Tailwind config updates, global CSS utilities like hero-chip/hero-cta) referenced in the change summary.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest focuses on specific text updates and constrains layout/text changes to requested updates only.

hallucinated_features.description: Project state summary describing the site as having "English + Gujarati mixed user-facing content."
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraint requires "Keep all user-facing text English-only." The updated/recorded project state description conflicts with that requirement and was not requested as part of this change.
